Name: Seasonal Eeveelutions Redux
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
This is simply a code update for the original Seasonal Eeveelutions mod for 1.6 by permission as stated in the original mod. No other changes have been made. See the original mod for credits and permissions, all are the same for this compatibility update. All sprites are under the credits and permissions of the original mod.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3822]Seasonal Eeveelutions[/url]﻿ by TerraBubbles

In the configuration menu, choose the color of the vanilla cat you want to replace. This should allow compatibility with some other cat recolor mods depending on the type of sprite replacement they use.
